controles.affirmation: Orange Business pese 18 % du chiffre d'affaires du groupe ; 'CA Orange Business H1 2026 : 3,503 Mds EUR, soit 18,1 % du chiffre d'affaires groupe (40,396 Mds EUR en FY2025)'.
controles.verbatim_source: Communique S1 2026, 30 June data : 'Revenues 20,948' (groupe, 6M 2026) et 'Orange Business 3,503'. Soit 16,7 %. Le 18,1 % correspond au ratio FY2025 : Orange Business 7,325 / groupe 40,396 (communique FY2025).
controles.correction_proposee: Le chiffre de 18,1 % est un ratio ANNUEL FY2025 (7 325 / 40 396). Rapporte au S1 2026, Orange Business pese 3 503 / 20 948 = 16,7 %. La formulation actuelle divise un semestre par un exercice complet et est arithmetiquement incoherente. Ecrire : '16,7 % du chiffre d'affaires du groupe au S1 2026 (18,1 % sur l'exercice 2025)'.

controles.affirmation: Le groupe presente cette evolution comme un 'trend improving'.
controles.verbatim_source: Aucune occurrence de 'trend improving' ni de 'improving trend' dans le communique S1 2026 ni dans les slides S1 2026. Le document ecrit : 'The transformation of Orange Business is ongoing, notably through the partnership with Tech Mahindra for international operations, WITH THE AIM OF gradually improving the sector's EBITDAaL trend amid a challenging environment.' Le titre de section est 'Transformation is making progress'.
controles.correction_proposee: Supprimer les guillemets autour de 'trend improving' ou citer le texte reel : le groupe dit viser une amelioration progressive de la tendance d'EBITDAaL, ce n'est pas un constat mais un objectif.

controles.affirmation: Le groupe vient de lancer une operation supplementaire, l'acquisition de Scorefit pour 1,3 Md EUR, UN MOIS APRES la cloture du semestre.
controles.verbatim_source: On July 1st, Orange COMPLETED the acquisition of Scorefit for a total amount of EUR1.3 billion. Scorefit, fully owned by a BNP Paribas subsidiary, holds fiber access purchased on the wholesale market in France for Orange. This acquisition SIMPLIFIES THE GROUP'S FINANCIAL STRUCTURE and is part of its financial strategy for the transition from copper to fibre.
controles.correction_proposee: L'acquisition a ete FINALISEE le 1er juillet 2026, soit le LENDEMAIN de la cloture du semestre, pas un mois apres. Et il ne s'agit pas d'une 'operation supplementaire' de croissance externe mais d'un rachat d'acces fibre deja utilises par Orange, presente par le groupe comme une simplification de sa structure financiere.

controles.affirmation: Titre : 'La cybersecurite classee risque n 1 par le groupe lui-meme'.
controles.verbatim_source: URD FY2025, section 2.2 : 'THESE CATEGORIES ARE NOT PRESENTED IN ORDER OF IMPORTANCE. However, within each category, risk factors are presented in descending order of importance as determined by Orange'. Le risque cyber est bien le premier de la section 2.2.1 Operational risks, niveau 'High ***'.
controles.correction_proposee: Ecrire 'premier risque OPERATIONNEL cite par le groupe' (ce que dit d'ailleurs correctement le corps de l'argument) et non 'risque n 1', l'URD precisant que les categories de risques ne sont pas classees entre elles.

controles.affirmation: Resultat net 3,6 Mds EUR (+3,7 Mds), gain comptable de 2,4 Mds sur la prise de controle de MasOrange, contre-effet de la provision GEPP de 1,3 Md en 2025 ; resultat net ajuste 1,35 Md EUR (+11,8 %).
controles.verbatim_source: Group net income amounted to EUR3.6 billion, a very significant increase of EUR3.7 billion, primarily due to a EUR2.4 billion gain following the acquisition of exclusive control of MasOrange and the counter-effect of a net provision of EUR1,3 billion in 2025 relating to the agreement on Employment and Career Path Planning for France (GEPP). Adjusted net income amounted to EUR1.35 billion, an increase of +11.8%.

controles.affirmation: Dette financiere nette de 22,526 Mds EUR fin 2025 a 35,7 Mds au 30 juin 2026 (+13,2 Mds), ratio dette nette/EBITDAaL a 2,4x contre 1,8x, objectif moyen terme autour de 2x ; rachat des 50 % de MasOrange detenus par Lorca pour 4,25 Mds.
controles.verbatim_source: Net financial debt stood at EUR35.7 billion at June 30, 2026, an increase of EUR13.2 billion primarily related to the acquisition of MasOrange. Net debt to EBITDAaL ratio rose to 2.4x, with the Group maintaining its target to return to a ratio of around 2x in the medium term. ; tableau : Net financial debt 35,683 / 22,526 ; ratio 2.40 / 1.80 ; 'Orange entered into a binding agreement with Lorca to acquire its 50% stake in MasOrange for EUR4.25 billion in cash'.

controles.affirmation: Orange Business : CA 3 503 M EUR (-3,1 %, -5,1 % en historique), EBITDAaL 232 M (-6,4 %) apres -7,2 % au S1 2025 ; voix -12,5 % et data -7,7 %.
controles.verbatim_source: Orange Business generated revenue of EUR3,503 million in the first half of 2026, representing a decline of -3.1%. EBITDAaL stood at EUR232 million, down -6.4% after a -7.2% decrease in the first half of 2025. ; table : Voice 300 (12.5)% ; Data 958 (7.7)% ; Revenues 3,503 (3.1)% (5.1)%.

controles.affirmation: Protocole d'accord du 6 juin 2026 avec Bouygues Telecom et Free pour racheter SFR a Altice France ; part Orange environ 27 % de la valeur d'entreprise (environ 5,6 Mds EUR) ; soumis aux autorites ; cloture possible au S2 2027 ; 'aucune certitude que la transaction sera menee a bien'.
controles.verbatim_source: On June 6, 2026, Orange announced, alongside Bouygues Telecom and Free-Groupe Iliad, the signing of a Memorandum of Understanding with Altice France for the acquisition of SFR ... Orange's share of the total enterprise value of the transaction (EUR20.35 billion) amounts to approximately 27%, or about EUR5.6 billion ... The completion of the transaction remains subject to approval by the relevant administrative, regulatory, and competition authorities ... The completion of the transaction could take place in the second half of 2027 ... At this stage, there is no certainty that the transaction will be completed.

controles.affirmation: Cybersecurite : verbatims 'increased cyber attacks and the compromise of its systems and data' et 'its image and reputation could be materially affected', niveau 'High ***', section 2.2.1.
controles.verbatim_source: 2.2.1 Operational risks — 'Orange could be exposed to increased cyber attacks and the compromise of its systems and data.' High *** ... 'its image and reputation could be materially affected and its earnings impacted.'

controles.affirmation: Fournisseurs critiques et hyperscalers : verbatims 'could pose a significant risk for Orange's activities' et 'serious consequences for its operations and profitability', niveau 'High ***'.
controles.verbatim_source: The concentration of certain critical suppliers, the growing use of outsourcing and supply tensions could pose a significant risk for Orange's activities. High *** ... Orange's dependence on certain key suppliers could have serious consequences for its operations and profitability. ... 'Other factors such as the increasing reliance on hyperscalers and the intensive use of large language models (LLM) for artificial intelligence further amplify this vulnerability.'

controles.affirmation: Etat francais + Bpifrance 22,95 % du capital et 29,04 % des droits de vote ; fonds d'epargne salariale 7,54 % du capital et 12,35 % des droits de vote.
controles.verbatim_source: v2-pipeline/ora.pa.json, voting_structure_note (verbatim cite par l'ATT). Coherent avec top_capital (Etat 13,39 + Bpifrance 9,56 = 22,95) et top_voting (21,04 + 8,00 = 29,04).
